limits.library_policy: Closed typed vocabulary; arbitrary imports are unsupported. Each extension requires pinned dependency, independent semantics and challenge checks.

library_registry.dependency_identity: The actual native build manifest binds its pinned Catala compiler, runtime and standard library.

date.add_days.domain: years 0001..9999; out of range is E_DATE_RANGE
date.add_days.inputs: Gregorian date and integer day count

date.add_months_clamped.domain: years 0001..9999; out of range is E_DATE_RANGE
date.add_months_clamped.inputs: Gregorian date and integer month count
date.add_months_clamped.result: shift the month and clamp the day to the destination month end

date.month_end.result: last date of the same month

list.length.domain: accepted observed lists within resource limits

list.sequence.domain: at most 10000 elements; excess is E_RESOURCE_LIMIT
list.sequence.result: begin inclusive to end exclusive, empty when end <= begin

numeric.max.domain: all values in the declared type
numeric.max.inputs: two values of the same integer, money_hkd or decimal type

numeric.min.domain: all values in the declared type
numeric.min.inputs: two values of the same integer, money_hkd or decimal type

limits.performance: No backend ranking; this report measures correctness evidence only.
limits.recursion: Recursive types are rejected by the pinned Catala compiler; recursive helpers and rule cycles are unsupported.

resource_preflight.note: Static resource envelope only; compiler and runtime limits still apply.

limits.source_quality: Source anchors and model criticism do not establish legal meaning or completeness.

assumptions: The specified constructor meanings and factual interface are the premises.
The independent parser and tree encoder implement the declared normalization.
scope.proved: The independently parsed formal proposal and typed shared model have identical constructor trees; every interpretation of those constructors yields the same result for every input context.

summary.statement: Checked formal and executable properties apply only to their recorded premises and domains. Legal source meaning, completeness and unknown future legal situations remain qualified.
